taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-a-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-14 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 161.1 | 3.39 | 3.39
2 | 1022.2 | 1.76 | 5.15
3 | 85.2 | 1.93 | 7.08
4 | 88.8 | 9.77 | 16.85
5 | 117.4 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as KHA-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: T-14
Curve type: KHA
Aquifer depth: 5.15 - 16.85 m
Recommendation: Focus drilling and screen placement in the 5.15–16.85 m interval, where resistivity drops to 85–89 ohm-m, suggesting a saturated, potentially permeable water-bearing zone sandwiched beneath the resistive layer 2; log cuttings carefully through this depth to distinguish clay from sand/gravel before finalizing screen placement.
